Hi I wondered if one could advise?  I'm trying to do a temporal project (I see 30 arc second grids are not supported). So I restart the modeling by loading 2.5 arc minute grids and get the following error.  Do I need to thin my samples again instead of just loading my previously thinned samples I used for the 30 arc second analysis? Unfortuneatly I forgot to save my session - and there's no way to pull out of this error. Also, so do I need to keep rerunning maxent base model to move on to the time projections?

Cheers, 
Bruce
